about: CaseClerk demo video, locked cut A (2026-10-26). Source of truth for timing; docs/submission/video-script.md is its readable form. scripts/build.py writes index.html, compositions/captions.html and compositions/overlays.html from this file and checks every line's pace. Times are seconds on the film clock; `in` is the offset into the normalised source clip.

standin.note: Stand-in for phase B: the VAB approval recorded 10/25 at 1440x900, pillarboxed on metal. Phase B replaces it with the VPY approval take.

camNote: cam: [film time, scale, x, y, move seconds]; the source pixel (px,py) lands at (x + scale*px, y + scale*py). Moves ease power2.inOut; 0 s is a cut. A shot's "window" keys [film time, top, right, bottom, left, move seconds] crop the footage to the rest of the frame (insets in px); the crop resets when the shot ends.
capNote: cap: where a line's caption breaks (|). Without it the line is one caption group.
